galery.title: My projects
galery.subtitle: Real websites built to improve online presence

projects.title: HomeSilva — Real estate website
projects.desc:
A real estate agency with over 15 years in the industry that needed a modern online presence to showcase their properties and generate new inquiries.

I designed and developed a digital property catalog with individual listings, search filters, interactive maps, and direct contact options, making it easy for visitors to find properties of interest and quickly get in touch with the agency.
The platform remains active and growing, continuously incorporating improvements and new features.

projects.title: Babaria — Cosmetics brand website
projects.desc:
A cosmetics brand with over 40 years in the market that needed to strengthen its digital presence and better communicate its brand identity.

I developed an 'About Us' section focused on telling the company's story, highlighting its key ingredients, and conveying its values through visual content and video.
The goal was to help visitors understand who is behind the brand before making a purchase decision, building trust and strengthening their connection with the products.

projects.title: DailyNotes — Mobile productivity app
projects.desc: A simple, customizable, and efficient notes app to boost your productivity. It lets you organize your day, set goals, and track your routines without wasting time. Available on Google Play, with folders, weekly tracking, and daily management.

projects.title: Nurani Timepieces — Watch brand website
projects.desc:
A premium watch brand specializing in imported products that needed its own online presence to showcase its collections and attract potential customers.

I designed and developed a web catalog with men's and women's collections, along with a contact form featuring a discount incentive to capture leads.
The goal was to provide the brand with a professional platform to present its products, strengthen its digital presence, and convert visitors into potential customers.

projects.title: Interior design studio website
projects.desc:
An interior design studio that needed a website capable of faithfully reflecting its visual identity and presenting its portfolio in a professional way.

I developed a custom landing page with a project gallery, original illustrations, and contact options, turning the client's design into a fully responsive web experience.
The project focused on respecting every visual detail on both desktop and mobile, ensuring a consistent brand experience and a polished presentation of the studio's work.

projects.title: Foodie Fusion — Restaurant website
projects.desc:
A restaurant that needed a professional online presence where customers could browse the menu, learn about the business, and easily access key information from any device.

I designed and developed a website with an online menu, dish gallery, location info, and personalized user features, creating a more accessible and engaging experience for visitors.
The goal was to help the restaurant present its services professionally, improve customer interaction, and keep all relevant information available online.

projects.title: Urban clothing website — Online store template
projects.desc: An online store with a shopping cart, product categories, and a profile with purchase history. Personal project. It works like a real store: you can add products, watch the total update in real time, and review your past purchases in your profile.

faqs.preg: How long does it take to build the website?
faqs.res: It depends on the project. A landing page can be ready in 1 to 2 weeks. An e-commerce or more complex site can take 3 to 5 weeks. I always give you a clear timeline before we start.

faqs.preg: How much does a website cost?
faqs.res: Every project is different, so I don't have fixed prices. But I can give you a free quote after a short conversation. Message me and we'll figure it out.

faqs.preg: Do I need to know about technology to work with you?
faqs.res: Not at all. I explain everything in plain language and guide you every step of the way. You focus on your business, I take care of the rest.

faqs.preg: Can I update the website myself afterward?
faqs.res: Yes. Depending on the type of project, I deliver the site with a simple panel so you can make basic changes without relying on anyone.

faqs.preg: What if I need changes after the site is published?
faqs.res: Minor adjustments during the delivery period are included at no extra cost. For later changes, we can set up a monthly maintenance plan or handle them on a case-by-case basis.

faqs.preg: Do you work with clients from any industry?
faqs.res: Yes. I've worked with restaurants, stores, cosmetics brands, real estate agencies, and more. If you have a business and need an online presence, I can help.
